scope: Add evaluated Android DSL provider names/configured directory facts and component asset roots to the existing Gradle project model; no tree policy, UI, active-provider selection or canonical parity changes.

model_contract.legacy_decoding: sourceProviders is an optional additive module property. Missing/null remains unknown; known empty is distinct. Existing module/default-variant/component/dependency decoding and assertions are preserved.
model_contract.order: gradleSourceSetIteration: encounter order of the evaluated Gradle Android source-set container; not textual declaration order or Studio active-provider/overlay order.
model_contract.names: Exact evaluated Android DSL sourceSet.name values, never inferred from a directory basename, component name or build variant.
model_contract.resources: Android res directories; JVM resources and other source categories are outside this bounded catalog.
model_contract.root_paths: Canonical Gradle file paths; Rust validates absolute project containment, lexical parent traversal and nearest-existing-ancestor symlink escape. Configured missing paths remain present.
model_contract.candidate_query: All configured containing provider candidates in reported order, one occurrence per provider, retaining shared/nested/mixed-kind ambiguity. Manifest matches only its exact configured file or exact parent directory. This is not a VFS existence query, first overlay winner, active provider filter or full getForFile ancestor-folder semantics.
model_contract.asset_roots: Evaluated component assets.all roots; generatedness uses assets.static plus exact evaluated DSL asset directories. AGP 9.4 static omits variant-specific configured paths, so the DSL union retains those as configured even when missing. No basename or build-folder classification for supported ordinary Android assets.
model_contract.producer_execution: Collector source inputs retain Gradle provider producer dependencies. The smoke explicitly requests createAssets and uses rerun-tasks. No APK assembly or unrelated task is requested.
unsupported: KMP source-provider catalogs remain unknown with an export diagnostic; the Android DSL catalog is not used to invent KGP source-set identities.
JVM modules have no Android provider catalog.

The catalog includes configured inactive providers and does not establish the selected variant's Studio provider order/scope. A tree adapter must preserve unknown/ambiguous identities rather than choosing the first catalog item.
Shader, ML model, baseline profile, keep rule, arbitrary custom and JVM-resource categories are not covered by this bounded root-kind enum.
Generated directory contents, VFS refresh/existence, colocation of generated and configured roots, and exact Studio generated-source model identity are not established merely by this raw model.
Existing Java/Kotlin/resource generatedness export behavior is unchanged by this assets-only correction.

Provider winners may change inside overlapping roots because Studio searches per directory/file. A future tree adapter needs per-entry active-scope/ordered lookup facts, not one provider annotation for an entire physical root.

reference.license: Apache-2.0; original notices retained unchanged in externally preserved sources. The smoke AssetGenerator registration adapts the 2019 AOSP test pattern and retains attribution plus LICENSE-APACHE.

findings.fact: Configured URLs include missing roots, unlike existing virtual-file collections; named provider identity and overlay order are explicit separate facts.

getForFile preserves multiple containing/contained candidates; findSourceRoot checks exact manifests/parent directories and existing VFS ancestry. The Rust configured-candidate API intentionally does not claim these active/VFS semantics.
First source-root lookup spans Java, Kotlin, res, aidl, renderscript, assets and jniLibs, so provider identity cannot be guessed from only one root category.

Current and all-provider lists differ; current overlay order is main, flavors, multi-flavor, build type and variant, with a noted flavor-order issue. Gradle source-set container iteration is not this order.
Tree lookup combines current main, host tests, device tests, test suites and test fixtures. The additive catalog does not establish those active scopes.
Configured assets and generated assets form distinct source groups.
Provider annotations depend on first actual source-root match across active providers, not root basenames.

Original generated-assets test checks evaluated model generated folders, writes/refreshes a nested asset, and asserts its exact tree path. The smoke only exercises evaluated export/producer facts, so this original method stays unported.

non_rust_exceptions.component: Gradle and Android Gradle Plugin runtime
non_rust_exceptions.reason: Official Gradle evaluation owns dynamic Android DSL/provider/task facts; replacing its execution with a Rust parser would not faithfully evaluate arbitrary Gradle builds. The existing minimal Groovy init script exports evaluated facts; validation, provider-candidate logic, selection and IDE code remain Rust.
Runs the official Gradle/AGP JVM runtime for the evaluated model smoke.
Official Android compile target and build-tool metadata used by AGP; no practical equivalent Rust Android platform distribution exists.
